findings.text: the head arm's log opens `revision: 19d9f51f...` — the dispatch base, not the revision the arm measured — and its command line reads `pytest -q <25 promotion test files> ...` with the file list left as a placeholder, so the log the manifest's after_suite points at for revision c5acfd59 neither names that revision nor the command that produced it and cannot show the delivered test file was among the twenty-five; line 3 does say "head arm, worktree changes applied" and my own run of the delivered file at c5acfd59 passes 15/15, so the result is supported while the log's provenance is not.

the caption says "each of the first six promotes without a hand edit" and "Every shape below is a review shape", but the figure it captions shows seven green boundaries (space, end, full stop, en dash, slash, close paren, comma) against three red, and the table beneath it lists nine promoting review shapes against two refusals, so the count matches neither artifact and the review-shape claim is contradicted by the two refusal rows that follow it.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against the dispatch base; c5acfd59 replaces the enumerated separator alternation `(?:\s|$|[,;:—\-()])` with the negative lookahead `(?!\w)` and extends the helper's docstring, adding no other behaviour, and 35283807 records the gate counts in the evidenced fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the plan's done-when is a promotion test on a review run whose manifest reads `commits: none (review node)` promoting with no commits and no refusal, with the same prose refused on an implement run; test_review_declaring_no_commits_promotes and test_implement_declaring_no_commits_over_its_own_path_is_refused both pass in my head arm, the wider-promoting direction is guarded by test_a_non_implement_role_cannot_hide_a_change_behind_the_prose, and the widened reading can only make the changed-manifest guard refuse more (reckon/crew/promotion.py:1452 -> 1553), so the direction of the widening is fail-closed.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is §3's extension — a review run whose commits field opens with an absence word and sentence punctuation promotes with no commits and no hand edit while the same prose on an implementing role is refused; my own base arm at 19d9f51f with the delivered test file shows exactly the full-stop and slash review cases red (2 failed, 13 passed) and my head arm at 35283807 shows 15 passed, so the boundary rule is what both cases measure, and the plan's own done-when shapes (parenthetical and comma) promote at head while the same prose on an implement run is refused.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records both commits, four changed paths, the focused run at the new head, the gate pair and the added-failure delta, and its after_suite claims revision c5acfd59 — which the log it names does not corroborate (FINDING gate-head.log:1).
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares four paths, and `git diff --stat 19d9f51f 35283807` lists exactly reckon/crew/promotion.py, tests/test_commitless_review_promotes.py, docs/evidence/fragments/the-audit-agrees-with-the-skill/commitless-boundary-is-any-non-word.html and docs/figures/the-audit-agrees-with-the-skill/commitless-boundary-is-any-non-word/boundary-rule.png, every one inside that set.

justifications.durability: the delivered file pins four punctuated shapes and the implement refusal, the negative control reddens exactly the two shapes the rule reads differently (full stop and slash) while leaving the two the enumerated set already handled, and the hiding direction is pinned by test_a_non_implement_role_cannot_hide_a_change_behind_the_prose passing in both of my arms; two of the five new cases are guards rather than new behaviour, which the run's own evidence does not distinguish, and the provenance gap below is what keeps this off the top.
justifications.evidence: two independently reproduced arms bracket the change — 2 failed and 13 passed at base source, 15 passed at the delivered head, both logged with the module path and cwd — and the added-failure delta is a measured zero over the run's own gate logs (10 ids identical on both sides, all inside the three files the base arm ran), but the after-suite log names the base revision and an unsubstituted placeholder command, so the revision the manifest attributes to it is uncorroborated.
justifications.fit: the change keeps the module's idiom of a compiled module-level constant with its rule in the adjacent comment and the reasoning in the helper's docstring, states the boundary in mechanism terms with no plan or ticket reference, keeps the absence vocabulary imported from the reports module rather than restating it, and the fragment reuses the plan's evidence layout and the project-absolute figure path.
justifications.goal_fidelity: my base arm is red on exactly the full-stop and slash review cases and green at the delivered head, the en-dash and close-paren cases were already handled by the enumerated set (the space before the en dash satisfied \s), and the plan's `commits: none (review node)` shape promotes on a review while the same prose on an implement run is still refused, so the goal holds at head.
justifications.scope_discipline: `git diff --stat 19d9f51f 35283807` lists four files and all four are inside the manifest's declared changed_paths, the package change is one regex constant and its docstring, and no shared plan or index state was touched.
